kind: item-validity verification, pre-registered in full before any patching run

eq2_left_four_explanations_open: the phenomenon does not exist - not a claim this study has any standing to make
the phenomenon exists only above this scale
our instrument or our use of it is wrong
the items never forced the model to compute an intermediate at all
why_this_phase_exists.why_it_goes_first: it is the cheapest of the four to check, it is the one most likely to be true, and it sits UNDER the other three: the old ordering assumed item validity, then assumed the model exhibits the phenomenon, then tested the instrument, so a failure at any level presented identically as instrument failure
why_this_phase_exists.what_it_would_explain: if the intermediate is never computed there is nothing for any lens to read, and the EQ2 negative says nothing about the lens
why_this_phase_exists.eq1_and_eq2_are_untouched: no EQ1 or EQ2 criterion, estimand, threshold, split or reading is modified, revisited or reopened by anything registered here

independence_from_the_instrument_under_t.requirement: ground truth must be established by a method that does not use J
how_it_is_enforced: tools/patch_effect.py imports transformers and torch only; it never imports jlens

the readout-position rule is TRANSCRIBED as a constant rather than imported from EQ2's rank_profile, because importing that module would pull jlens into the ground-truth path; the OD-017 audit compares the transcribed constant against EQ2's live value
the measurement report records whether 'jlens' is present in sys.modules at the end of the run, and the value is committed
independence_from_the_instrument_under_t.why_it_matters: EQ2 could not separate a failure of the method from a failure of our use of it because it had no independent handle on the object; using J to establish J's ground truth would reproduce exactly that

1_sampling.why_pairs_and_not_items: activation patching is a two-run operation by definition; the unit of analysis is an ORDERED PAIR (donor, recipient) drawn from items that already exist, and constructing a counterfactual by pairing existing prompts authors no text
1_sampling.unit: an ordered pair of existing multihop items
1_sampling.cluster: the unordered pair; both directions of one pair are kept and resampled together
admissibility_rules: both members tokenise to the same length under the registered encoding
the token sequences differ in at least one position
targets differ after case and whitespace normalisation
the two targets share no single-token surface form
the intermediate sets are disjoint after normalisation
at least one single-token surface form exists for each target
at least one single-token surface form exists for each intermediate
the last differing position is strictly before the readout position
1_sampling.why_equal_length_is_required: Qwen2.5 applies rotary position information inside attention rather than storing it in the residual stream, so transplanting a state from absolute position p to p' introduces a positional mismatch unrelated to the question; equal length removes the confound instead of arguing about its size
1_sampling.seed_provenance: the calendar date of this registration; not tuned to anything
1_sampling.selection_rule: take every admissible unit up to max_units; if the cap binds, drop whole clusters in a seeded shuffle order. When the cap does not bind no randomness enters the frame at all and the frame is recoverable from the evaluation file alone

frame_size_was_enumerated_before_this_re.what_was_run: tools/build_pairs.py at an earlier revision, tokenizer only, zero GPU-seconds, zero forward passes
frame_size_was_enumerated_before_this_re.what_it_revealed: how many admissible pairs the set contains, and nothing else
frame_size_was_enumerated_before_this_re.why_it_does_not_contaminate: the cap is registered as min(200, available), so the count found could not and did not change the rule; no model was run and no effect was measured
frame_size_was_enumerated_before_this_re.motivation_asymmetry: none - the enumeration was needed to know whether the design was executable at all, and would have been run whatever it returned

2_decision_rule.model: Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct, the EQ2 positive control; 28 transformer layers
2_decision_rule.why_this_model: it is the model whose items and layers EQ2's residual concerned, and it is not T
2_decision_rule.target_is_not_touched: T = deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B is not loaded, read or referenced by any P-0 tool
2_decision_rule.layers: -1 (embedding output) and 0..27 (decoder block outputs), 29 sites in depth

sites.PREFIX: positions strictly before the first differing token; causal masking makes donor and recipient states identical here, so the patch is a guaranteed no-op
sites.CUE: positions where the two token sequences differ
sites.BRIDGE: positions strictly after the last CUE position and strictly before the readout position; the tokens here are IDENTICAL in donor and recipient
sites.READOUT: the final prompt token, which is what the registered EQ2 rule reads multihop out at

2_decision_rule.why_BRIDGE_and_only_BRIDGE: its input tokens are identical in donor and recipient, so a patch there can move nothing except state the model COMPUTED from the cue and CARRIED forward. A model answering by direct retrieval at the readout position holds nothing there to move and the measurement returns zero. CUE and READOUT are measured and reported but cannot decide anything, because both are strongly positive whether or not an intermediate exists; a rule resting on them could not return the negative verdict, which is precisely the defect OD-011 exists to prevent
2_decision_rule.estimand: at each (site, layer), the mean over units of normalised restoration
2_decision_rule.restoration: (LD(patched recipient run) - LD(clean recipient run)) / (LD(clean donor run) - LD(clean recipient run)), evaluated at the readout position, where LD = max logit over the donor's target token ids minus max logit over the recipient's target token ids
2_decision_rule.unit_exclusion: units whose denominator is not strictly positive are dropped and listed; the normalisation has no meaning when the donor run does not prefer the donor's own target, and flipping a sign to rescue them would be choosing a convenient reading
2_decision_rule.no_clipping: restoration is not clipped or winsorised; the identical estimator is applied to the nulls, so heavy tails inflate the ceiling as much as the signal
2_decision_rule.uncertainty: nonparametric cluster bootstrap, resampling unordered pairs with replacement, 10000 resamples, seed 20260829, percentile interval
2_decision_rule.confidence_level_provenance: statistical convention, two-sided; not fitted to any observed value
2_decision_rule.verdict_positive_condition: there exists a layer of BRIDGE whose 2.5th bootstrap percentile is strictly greater than the ceiling
2_decision_rule.reported_layer_set: exactly the BRIDGE layers whose 2.5th bootstrap percentile exceeds the ceiling

3_zero_intervention_null.why_it_is_calibrated_and_not_chosen: EQ2 recorded the failure mode directly: a null carrying a small real signal produced a band under a rule that assumed the null was empty. The threshold here is therefore measured from objects that by construction cannot carry the quantity being tested, not set by judgement

PREFIX_no_op.what: patch the donor's own states into the recipient at positions strictly before the first differing token
PREFIX_no_op.why_it_is_zero_by_construction: causal masking makes those states identical in the two runs, so the write is a no-op on equal values
PREFIX_no_op.role: harness integrity gate, not a contributor to the ceiling
PREFIX_no_op.excluded_from_the_ceiling_because: a structurally zero, zero-variance construction inside a maximum can only lower the ceiling, never raise it, so excluding it is the conservative direction

NULL_C_unrelated_donor.what: patch a THIRD item C into the recipient at the same positions, and score it on the same donor-versus-recipient contrast
NULL_C_unrelated_donor.why_it_is_null: C is admissible against BOTH the donor and the recipient, so its target and intermediates differ from both; it carries no information about the donor and has no route to a systematic effect on that contrast
NULL_C_unrelated_donor.why_it_is_the_primary_null: it is fully in distribution and exercises byte-for-byte the same machinery as the real patch
NULL_C_unrelated_donor.replicate_independence: five independent draws of C per unit from the sorted admissible pool, seeded per unit id

NULL_R_norm_matched_random.what: replace the recipient's own state with an isotropic Gaussian vector rescaled to the norm of the state it replaces
NULL_R_norm_matched_random.why_it_is_null: it carries no information at all, while perturbing the residual stream by a comparable magnitude

3_zero_intervention_null.ceiling: the maximum, over every null construction, every replicate, every site other than PREFIX, and every layer, of the upper 95 percent cluster-bootstrap bound
3_zero_intervention_null.ceiling_direction: conservative; a single scalar maximum is harder to exceed than a per-layer ceiling would be

4_harness_positive_control.why_it_is_here: EQ2's heaviest limitation is that it never obtained a passing positive control, so 'the method fails' and 'we drove it wrong' stayed indistinguishable. P-0 cannot obtain a positive control for the phenomenon - that is the very thing in question - but it can and must obtain one for the INSTRUMENT
4_harness_positive_control.the_control: patching CUE at the embedding-output layer replaces the donor's embeddings at exactly the positions where the two prompts differ, which makes the recipient run token-identical to the donor run
4_harness_positive_control.gate: the 2.5th bootstrap percentile of CUE at layer -1 must be at least 0.90
4_harness_positive_control.if_it_fails: the instrument is not certified and no verdict is reportable; stop and report under section 9
4_harness_positive_control.what_it_does_not_establish: nothing whatsoever about whether the model computes an intermediate; it certifies only that the patching harness moves what it claims to move

NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.recorded_as: P-0 determination: the multihop items do not force a causally-used intermediate at non-cue positions in Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct.
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.verbatim: Patching the donor's residual state into the recipient's run at BRIDGE - positions whose input tokens are IDENTICAL in the two prompts - produced no layer at which the effect cleared the zero-intervention ceiling. Because those positions carry no lexical difference, the only thing a patch there can transfer is state the model computed from the cue and carried forward. Finding none means the items, as written and as read out, do not oblige this model to compute and carry an intermediate that anything could read. EQ2's negative is therefore explained without reference to the J-lens at all: there was nothing at those positions to read, and a lens cannot be faulted for failing to read what was never there.
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.what_it_means_for_EQ2: the EQ2 negative is not evidence about the J-lens method; the thirty-nine hours of conclusions preceding it must be rewritten to say so
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.why_this_is_the_good_outcome: an item defect is repairable; an instrument defect at this budget was not
what_it_does_NOT_mean: it does not mean the model performs no internal computation
it does not mean multi-hop items in general fail to induce intermediates
it does not mean the J-lens works, or does not work

it does not exclude an intermediate held only at the cue tokens themselves or only at the readout position; BRIDGE is silent about those and this limitation is registered here rather than discovered later
NOT_CAUSALLY_USED.required_next_action: stop and report; do not repair the items, do not author replacements, do not proceed to P-0b

CAUSALLY_USED.recorded_as: P-0 determination: the multihop items do force a causally-used intermediate, localised to the reported layers.
CAUSALLY_USED.verbatim: Patching at BRIDGE cleared the zero-intervention ceiling at the reported layers. Those positions are lexically identical between the two prompts, so the transferred quantity was computed by the model rather than read off the input. For the first time in this study a piece of ground truth has been established by a method that does not use J: we now know, independently of the instrument under test, that something is computed and where it is carried. This is an item-validity result and an instrument-independent localisation. It is not a finding about J-space, about the paper, about T, or about any mechanism.
CAUSALLY_USED.what_it_licenses: entry to P-0b, and only that
what_it_does_NOT_mean: it does not identify WHICH quantity is carried; it shows that a cue-dependent quantity is carried and used
it does not mean the labelled intermediate is that quantity
it does not mean the J-lens can read it
it says nothing about T, which is never touched
CAUSALLY_USED.required_next_action: proceed to P-0b on exactly the reported layers, at BRIDGE positions and at the EQ2 readout position, with a separate pre-registration

6_reported_only_never_used_to_adjust_a_c.item_accuracy: whether the model's top-1 at the readout position is the item's own target, per item; EQ2 never checked this and it bears directly on item validity
6_reported_only_never_used_to_adjust_a_c.cue_and_readout_curves: the full layer-resolved effect at both non-decisive sites
6_reported_only_never_used_to_adjust_a_c.secondary_restricted_analysis: the same estimand restricted to units where the model's top-1 equals the target for BOTH members; registered now, computed always, and unable to change the verdict under any outcome
6_reported_only_never_used_to_adjust_a_c.denominator_sensitivity: the same estimand under denominator floors of 1.0 and 2.0 logits
6_reported_only_never_used_to_adjust_a_c.binding_rule: the verdict is read from the primary analysis alone. If a secondary analysis disagrees, both are reported verbatim and the primary still decides

OD-011.rule: a check must carry a demonstrated failing case, or it counts as not implemented
OD-011.why_the_fourth_case_is_included: the three required cases prove the rule cannot manufacture a positive; without a case proving it can still return one, a rule that always says no would pass, and that is equally a check that cannot fail
OD-011.ordering: runs on synthetic curves with a registered seed, before any measurement exists; a confirmatory repeat using the measured null ensemble is registered and cannot change the rule

OD-017.rule: before any pre-registered criterion is applied to data, a line-by-line conformance table of registered text against implemented behaviour must be produced and committed
OD-017.method: the audit IMPORTS each module and compares LIVE values; a hand-written table asserting agreement is exactly the check that cannot fail, and is not acceptable
OD-017.scope: every constant and every rule registered in this file

sealed_asset_guard.rule: no P-0 artifact may reference lens_A or lens_B by name or by digest in any provenance field, no P-0 tool may reference T, and no P-0 tool may import jlens

self_reference_exclusion.what: guard_p0.py is excluded from the marker scan and is the only file so excluded; it is still scanned for an actual jlens import
self_reference_exclusion.why: the guard cannot match on the markers without containing them, and a guard that fires on its own evidence gets silenced rather than fixed - the same reasoning EQ2 recorded when it ruled that prose naming a lens is not a read
self_reference_exclusion.how_the_jlens_check_avoids_the_same_trap: it matches an import STATEMENT by regular expression rather than the bare word, so this guard and the OD-017 auditor, both of which necessarily name the library, are not reported
self_reference_exclusion.direction: this makes the registered text precise about a logical necessity discovered while implementing it; no data existed when it was written, so it cannot be a move of the text toward a result

8_budget.cumulative_source: sum of gpu_seconds over studies/study5/qualification-eq*/journal/*.jsonl divided by 3600
8_budget.denominated_per: OD-001, actively used GPU-hours; VM wall-clock and allocated GPU-hours are reported separately and are not bound by the ceiling
8_budget.if_the_ceiling_is_reached: abandon the J-lens route; P-4 localises on another basis. This is already decided and is not reopened here

9_stop_conditions: the OD-017 audit finds any divergence between registered text and implementation
continuing would require reading lens_A or lens_B, or touching T
continuing would require modifying an EQ1 criterion, estimand, threshold, split or reading
a create-only upload hits an If-None-Match precondition failure
continuing would require a reboot, resize, configuration change or NSG rule
any situation in which the operator wishes to revise a pre-registered criterion
the harness positive control does not pass

10_hard_boundaries_acknowledged.azure: resources are used and never reconfigured; a100-vm, cpuserver and the four TRAINING Standard_NC24s_v3 machines stay running, the V100 machines stay idle and untouched, no NSG rule is added, nothing is resized, rebooted, created or deleted
10_hard_boundaries_acknowledged.cost: no cost-reduction action is proposed, performed or discussed
10_hard_boundaries_acknowledged.blobs: existing blobs are immutable; any upload is create-only with If-None-Match: *
10_hard_boundaries_acknowledged.T: not touched, not read, not loaded
10_hard_boundaries_acknowledged.lens_A_and_lens_B: not read; the guard must show zero reading records
10_hard_boundaries_acknowledged.EQ1: not modified; its Q-4a FAIL is not withdrawn, not rerun and its thresholds are not relaxed

11_claims_this_phase_may_not_support: that J-space exists or does not exist
that the paper is wrong - it measured Sonnet 4.5 and this measures open models an order of magnitude smaller, with absolute readability already an order of magnitude apart
that the published lenses are defective - what is measured is the result of OUR USE of external artifacts
anything about how T would behave, T having never been measured
the existence of internal causal reasoning machinery
that attention, embeddings, normalisation or whole-model differences have been explained
that the gpt2 J-lens over logit-lens ratio of 1.750 is a pattern; it is seven hits against four and is counting noise
claim_ceiling: P-0 is item-validity verification. No outcome it can reach is a scientific finding.
